content.title: Taylor Frankie Paul's 3 Kids: What to Know About Indy, Ocean and Ever
content.text: Taylor Frankie Paul with her daughter Indy and son Ocean in July 2025; Taylor Frankie Paul and her son Ever in March 2025. Credit : Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram (2) NEED TO KNOW Taylor Frankie Paul has three children: Indy, Ocean and EverThe reality star welcomed daughter Indy and son Ocean with her ex-husband, Tate PaulEver, her son with ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen, was born in March 2024 Taylor Frankie Paul is a mother of three children. Taylor shares daughter Indy and son Ocean with her ex-husband, Tate Paul. She later welcomed her son Ever with her ex-boyfriend, Dakota Mortensen, in March 2024. On March 19, ABC canceled her already-filmed season of The Bachelorette after TMZ published a 2023 video showing the reality star throwing chairs at Dakota in front of her daughter. “Taylor is very grateful for ABC’s support as she prioritizes her family’s safety and security,” a spokesperson for The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star said in a statement obtained by PEOPLE. The statement continued, “After years of silently suffering extensive mental and physical abuse as well as threats of retaliation, Taylor is finally gaining the strength to face her accuser and taking steps to ensure that she and her children are protected from any further harm." Dakota also spoke out in a statement to PEOPLE, saying, "As anyone who has seen the video will understand, this is a deeply upsetting situation. I am, unfortunately, used to these baseless claims about me and our relationship, which I categorically deny. I am focusing on our son and his safety, and hope that Taylor will do the same." The resurfaced video is tied to Taylor’s 2023 arrest on misdemeanor charges, including assault, criminal mischief and committing domestic violence in the presence of a child. Six months after the incident, Paul entered a plea in abeyance to a third-degree felony count of aggravated assault. The MomTok founder served one day in jail, and her four other charges were dismissed with prejudice. Here’s everything to know about Taylor Frankie Paul’s three children: Indy, Ocean and Ever. Indy May Paul, 8 Taylor Frankie Paul and Indy in 2023. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram Taylor and her ex-husband, Tate, welcomed their first child together, daughter Indy May, on Aug. 31, 2017, nine months after they married. The following day, she announced her birth with an Instagram post. “Indy May Paul officially arrived Aug 31st weighing 6lbs 9oz. She is perfection and we are so obsessed with our baby girl. 💗 we are so blessed,” she wrote alongside a photo of her and Tate with their newborn daughter in the hospital. Related Stories Following her birth, Taylor has continued sharing photos of Indy, including various milestones and holidays. She also described Indy as being both “sweet” and “sassy” in an Instagram post for her 4th birthday. Indy on her first day of kindergarten in August 2022. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram Indy was present during Taylor's February 2023 physical outburst. In the video that was released in March 2026, Taylor can be seen throwing chairs at him while her daughter was in the room. The child could be heard crying as Dakota and Taylor continued fighting. Ocean Paul, 5 Ocean in August 2024. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram Taylor and Tate welcomed their second child, son Ocean, on June 18, 2020. In December 2019, the influencer announced that she was expecting on Instagram. “Walking into second trimester✨(my fav trimester) baby Paul will be here June 2020! Also Thank you everyone for the kind words and support yesterday🙏🏼,” she wrote alongside mirror photos of her cradling her growing bump. Following the announcement, Taylor began documenting her pregnancy on TikTok, and in June, she shared a video, introducing her newborn son to the world. “Ocean Paul arrived 4 days ago. 6 lbs 15 oz with lots of hair and a sweet soul,” she wrote in the caption. Ocean in April 2024. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram On her son's first birthday in June 2021, Taylor shared a series of photos of their family on social media. "I refuse to believe it’s been a year with my Ocean, but the calendar says otherwise🥺," she wrote. "Happy birthday to my sweet boy." Ever True Mortensen, 2 Taylor Frankie Paul and Ever in 2025. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram Shortly after her divorce, Taylor began dating Dakota and the couple welcomed their first baby together, son Ever True, on March 19, 2024. In September 2023, Taylor announced that she was pregnant, almost a year after experiencing an ectopic pregnancy. “One year later we've been blessed with our rainbow baby,” she wrote in a now-deleted Instagram post. “It's been a very emotional journey from last year till now and I can honestly say I'm so excited for this new chapter of life with Dakota, my children and this baby.” She went on to note that although she was feeling both excitement and anxiety, her pregnancy was "healthy and on track." Taylor Frankie Paul and ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen with son Ever on his 1st birthday in March 2025. Taylor Frankie Paul/Instagram In April 2024, Taylor shared that her son was born a month earlier. “Ever True was born March 19th, 6lbs 15oz a week early and we’ve had the best two weeks with him. We all love you so much, thank you for blending our family 🤍,” she wrote on Instagram. A few weeks later, she explained why they chose his moniker, writing on Instagram, “The name Ever meaning: always, eternity, and strong as a boar.” In March 2025, the couple — who have been on-again, off-again since their September 2024 split — reunited to celebrate their son’s first birthday. Ever has been featured several times on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives.
